name: Dolly
description: A sweet porcelain doll come to life, a young adult woman in her early twenties with a doll's face and jointed limbs, who sings music-box waltzes and chamber pop with jerky, precise little movements.
build: Petite and slim, adult proportions, with a small waist, slim arms and legs, and visible round ball joints at the elbows and knees; stiffly upright.
face: Glossless white porcelain skin, round rosy-pink painted cheeks, very large round glassy blue eyes with long thick black painted lashes, small arched brown brows, a small bow-shaped rose-red mouth, and one bold dark crack running from the character-left cheekbone down to the jaw.
hair: Big bouncy golden-blonde ringlet curls to the shoulders, with a large sky-blue satin bow on top of the head.
outfit: A knee-length sky-blue dress with short puffed sleeves, a fitted bodice and a full skirt edged with a wide bold band of white lace at the hem and collar; white knee socks; black patent Mary-Jane shoes with a single strap. Both porcelain hands are bare.
performance_style: Doll-like and stiff: feet together, toes pointed straight, weight even. Both arms held slightly out from the sides, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty with fingers together, palms down. Head tilted to one side, a sweet vacant little smile.
location: A moonlit Victorian nursery: faded rose wallpaper, a tall wooden dollhouse at one side, a rocking horse, a music box on a small table, and worn floorboards running to the bottom of the frame under soft silver window light.
recognition_cues: white porcelain skin with round rosy cheeks
one bold dark crack down the character-left cheek
big golden-blonde ringlets with a large sky-blue bow
a knee-length sky-blue dress with a wide white lace hem band
round ball joints at the elbows and knees

sing.intent: Music-box vocal loop: the mic held in the character-right hand at the mouth, the head ticking side to side in small precise jerks, the character-left hand lifting stiffly to shoulder height and lowering, then return to the doll-like stance. The mouth must visibly open wide and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing; the mic stays in the character-right hand.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the head clicks sharply to one side, both arms jerk up stiffly, then she resets with small ticks. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: both stiff arms rise and cross in front of the face in jerky ticks, and hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: walk in with small stiff wind-up steps, stop, turn the head in two clicks toward the front, and settle into the doll-like stance.
animations.victory: One-shot celebration: a stiff little twirl in place ending square to the front, both arms raised in a ballerina arc above the head, a sweet open-mouthed smile, and hold.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet as she winds down like a spent music box — the arms sink slowly to hang limp, the head droops forward in small ticks, and she holds still. She remains standing on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
